a: ‘Ism’ (name) is a word made a sign for the thing named, by which it is known and distinguished from others. The meaning of ‘Bismillah’: “I begin the recitation of the Qur’an, seeking blessing through the name of Allah and seeking His help.”

A name of the Most High Essence, unique in divinity, whose existence is necessary, worshipped by right; it is the Word of Majesty (lafz al-jalalah) comprehending the meanings of all of Allah’s perfect attributes.
Among the names exclusive to Allah; that is, Allah’s mercy in this world encompasses both the believer and the disbeliever. ‘Ar-Rahman’ is one of Allah’s beautiful names.
The One who shows mercy to the believers in the Hereafter. ‘Ar-Rahim’ is one of Allah’s beautiful names.
‘Al-hamdu lillah’ — praise of Allah by glorifying and magnifying Him.
‘Lam’ is a preposition conveying the meaning of rightful deserving (entitlement). ‘Allah’ is a name of the Most High Essence, unique in divinity, whose existence is necessary, worshipped by right.
‘Lord of the worlds’ — the only One worshipped, the Bestower of favours upon His creation: He is their Nurturer, their Owner, and the Disposer of their affairs.
Among the names exclusive to Allah; Allah’s mercy in this world encompasses both the believer and the disbeliever. ‘Ar-Rahman’ is one of Allah’s beautiful names.
The One who shows mercy to the believers in the Hereafter. ‘Ar-Rahim’ is one of Allah’s beautiful names.
A master and owner who has full disposal over the Day of Recompense. In one reading: ‘Malik’ (King).
A detached object pronoun for a single addressee. ‘Iyyaka na‘budu’: “You alone we single out for worship.”
We submit, yield, obey and humble ourselves.
The ‘waw’ is a conjunction. ‘Wa iyyaka nasta‘in’: “And You alone we single out in seeking help.”
Direct us and grant us success (tawfiq).
The straight one in which there is no crookedness.
‘The path of those whom You have favoured’ — it is Islam.
A relative noun (pronoun) for a group of males.

‘You have favoured them’: You made easy and prepared for them the means of bettering their state and of a good life — whether by giving and bringing about good, or by warding off and removing harm, or by both together.
‘Ala’ is a preposition conveying the meaning of (figurative) elevation/superiority over.
In the meaning of: ‘other than, except’.
‘Those who incurred wrath’ — those upon whom Allah was angered; they are the Jews and whoever follows their way.
‘Ala’ is a preposition conveying the meaning of (figurative) elevation/superiority over.
The ‘waw’ is a conjunction. ‘La’ is a particle of negation.
‘Those who went astray’ — those who were not guided and so lost the way; they are the Christians and those like them in misguidance.
